title: Explain your contribution
text: What did you personally do in the team?

options.text: I did everything, so other members are not important.
options.response: 这一说法忽略了关键条件，需要重新分析。

options.text: I helped the team, mainly with some experiments.
options.response: 提到了部分处理方式，但解释还不完整。

options.text: I implemented the data processing and checked the results with my teammates.
options.response: 回答说明了关键条件和处理方法。
